items.text: "Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata" haa jedhu.
"Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata" haa jedhan.
innis deebii naa kenne; iddoo balʼaas na qubachiise.
na wajjin jira; ani hin sodaadhu;
na wajjin jira; inni gargaaraa koo ti.
jabina kootii fi faarfannaa koo ti;
Ani nan jiraadha malee hin duʼu;
garuu dabarsee duʼatti na hin kennine.
kan qajeeltonni ittiin ol galanii dha.
Ati deebii naa kenniteertaatii, ani sin galateeffadha;
Ati Waaqa koo ti; ani sin galateeffadha;
ati Waaqa koo ti; anis sin leellisa.
